hero.title: Counselling and Psychotherapy in Ashford Kent.
hero.subtitle: In-person or online.
hero.body: Whether you are seeking support for yourself, your child, or a loved one, you are in the right place. Counselling HQ is a calm and confidential space to feel understood and move forward at your own pace.

welcome.title: Welcome to Counselling HQ
welcome.panel1Body: I work with adults, young people, and children who may be experiencing anxiety, low mood, grief and loss, relationship difficulties, separation and divorce, or significant life changes and transitions. I also have experience supporting children, young people, and adults with neurodiversity, including ADHD and autism.
welcome.panel2Body: Face-to-face sessions in Ashford, Kent with online video and telephone sessions available.
welcome.panel3Body: A warm, non-judgemental space where your experiences are taken seriously and your voice is valued.

about.title: About me
about.body1: Hello, I am Natasha, though most people call me Tasha. Before training as a counsellor, I spent 24 years as a teacher, supporting children and young people aged 5 to 18 through academic pressure, emotional challenges, and major life changes.
about.body2: I now work in schools and have a private practice with children and adults in short and long-term therapy. I believe in the quiet power of being truly listened to.
about.panelBody: I am a qualified counsellor holding a Level 4 CPCAB Diploma in Therapeutic Counselling and a Level 5 CPCAB Diploma in Psychotherapeutic Counselling. I am a Registered Member of the British Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (BACP) and work in accordance with the BACP Ethical Framework.

how.title: How I work
how.body: My approach is integrative, holistic, and person-centred. This means I tailor therapy to your unique experiences, drawing on evidence-based approaches when helpful.
how.panel1Body: CBT-informed tools, Transactional Analysis, Internal Family Systems, Gestalt, psychodynamic therapy, and creative methods.
how.panel2Body: A gentle, strengths-based approach that honours your pace and consent.

support.title: Ways I can support you
support.panel1Body: Anxiety, depression, stress, grief, peri-menopause, neurodiversity, and low self-esteem.
support.panel2Body: Anxiety, school challenges, loss, family change, emotional regulation, and play-based support.

fees.body: There is no pressure to have the right words. You can show up feeling unsure, overwhelmed, or quiet. A free 15-minute introductory call is available.
fees.line1: £60 per therapeutic hour (50 minutes). Concessions available for low-waged earners and student counsellors.

location.title: Location and sessions
location.panel1Body: The Oast, Park Barn Farm, Canterbury Road, Ashford, Kent. TN25 4EW
location.panel2Body: Online video and telephone sessions are available. I aim to respond to emails within 48 hours.

note.body: Counselling HQ is not an emergency service. If you are in crisis, contact your GP, call 999 if in immediate danger, or reach Samaritans on 116 123.
